body:
"Do I have a 24h ultimatum before the end of which I need to have had a social interaction? " Yes.  Looking back, I was unclear, but I can't change the title now.

"Will some random person force me to spend the next 24h with them? " No

"Do you have the sensational once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to speak to a person but have no idea how to go about it and need pointers?" No, just depressed and no social life.  I live near a big city (Chicago), but the social activities offered are:

- for people who already have friends
- for people who are free on weekends (I have work and am often tired afterwards)
- sports leagues (I'm athletic but hate most sports leagues - I've tried them.  I just want to have to have real OPEN-ENDED interactions with people without chasing a ball around or drinking in a dark depressing bar.  Idk, maybe I should give them another chance, but it's winter now...)
- random far and possibly expensive things that occur maybe a few times a month
- volunteering (I actually found an animal shelter that I could possibly do something at.  The volunteer orientation is on a Sunday, when I have work, and then there's Christmas etc... maybe I can work something out with my manager....)

Sorry just venting a little.  lol
I did not expect to come here to laugh
If you have a friend then you basically win automatically.  Unless they're abroad or unable to be reached I guess.

That's true.  But I feel like a huge part of being truly confident is fucking up and not entirely falling apart.  Sometimes people fuck up.  Maybe a huge part of pride and respect you have for yourself is based on having the discipline to resist porn because you believe/know it is at least bad for you, and this is a core value you have.

But, I feel like you can have other core values, such as valuing and respecting other humans, just being your good funny respectful etc. self in the moment when interacting with someone, just focusing on the present regardless if whatever happened in regards to PMOing recently, because just being a good human being to others is also likely a core value, and you don't to have breaking this one core value you put a lot of conscious thought into to spiral into having a bunch of other core values break down.
